description: This file provides CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) functions for managing notes via SQLAlchemy ORM. It defines functions to create, list, retrieve, update, and delete notes associated with a specific user.

methods.name: Note create_note(db: Session, owner_id: int, data: NoteCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new note for a specified owner using provided data.

methods.name: List[Note] list_notes(db: Session, owner_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all notes belonging to a specific owner.

methods.name: Optional[Note] get_note(db: Session, note_id: int, owner_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a specific note by ID for the owner, returns None if not found.

methods.name: Optional[Note] update_note(db: Session, note_id: int, owner_id: int, data: NoteUpdate)
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing note if it belongs to the specified owner.

methods.name: bool delete_note(db: Session, note_id: int, owner_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a note if it belongs to the specified owner, returns True if successful.
